Zj.bar_b_note: Strong creature silhouettes, but the fight plays on a flat, sky-less grass carpet under one dull mid-tone grade with cotton-ball dust puffs and no Valheim-class light or atmosphere.

Wq.bar_b_note: Murky brown-black frames with no purple storm sky, flat magenta telegraph rings, a barely visible player creature and debug-style HUD panels covering much of every frame sink it.

Xf.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing, readable villager, but its rounder cartoon finish leans away from the key art's stylised realism and it is shown only on a black void with no world light.

Om.bar_b_note: Side A frames the creatures clearly but on a flat grass carpet; side B's low camera buries the fight behind foreground grass, so neither has the clarity or atmosphere of the Palworld shots.

Cm.bar_b_note: Readable creatures, but low occluded framing (A) or a carved prop clipping into frame (B), on a flat grass carpet with no sky or light shafts, keep it below Palworld finish.

Nq.bar_b_note: Sky, distance and readable props help, but smeared low-resolution ground textures and a flat midday grade keep it short of Palworld density and Valheim light; B also leaves enemy banners standing after the win.

Vp.bar_b_note: B's furred boar gets near the naturalistic bar but its lumpy gold back patches and trainer-height scale fall short; A's smooth clay-toy surface with moss decals looks like a placeholder.

Th.bar_b_note: A wooden banner post blocks the fight in most of A's frames and both sides cut to a low grass-level camera at the end, all under a flat grade with no sky or atmosphere.

top_changes.change: Make the production fight camera keep both creatures and the trainer in frame at mid height: never drop it behind foreground grass or slopes (Om B, Cm A, Th f30-32), push props and banner posts out of the near plane (Th A f18-f28, Zj B f12-f13, Cm B f10-f16), and pull Stormwood fight cameras out of trunks and canopy (Wq B i12-i15).
Give the badger and boar real hit-react, stagger and lean animations (body compression, head snap, recoil step) for every hit and dodge, so hurt and moving frames stop holding the idle silhouette.

Re-light and re-dress the fight grounds: break the uniform grass carpet with paths, rocks, clearings and wildflower patches; widen the value range with warm sun, rim light and some sky or cool distance in frame; replace the cotton-ball dust puffs and flat magenta telegraph rings with grounded dust, stone and lightning impacts; and trim Wq's debug HUD panels.
